goal_scope: Nine existing current-BETA PCBs; ARGB remains excluded.

candidate.sourcing_note: The exact JLC-native catalog entry was found. A later live fetch returned HTTP 429; do not turn cached prices/stock into a purchase or budget assertion. No order was placed.

official_library_shadow.note: This library cites an older manufacturer drawing. Its 0.65 mm holes, 1.45 mm lands and wide-group X centers differ from the current drawing's nominal recommendation. A passing shadow DRC does not qualify those changes, assembly tolerances, or contact coverage. The library has not been installed as the new project selection.
official_library_shadow.logical_shell_alias_for_shadow: SH mapped to existing S1; no net names or pad UUIDs changed.

pcie-8pin-3port.note: 31 opens disappear because the existing GND plane cache is rebuilt; that independent fill-only improvement was separately received with the ORIGINAL selected connector.

atx-24pin-rev3.note: The first generic branch classifier rejected the source's authored Default class; that spelling restriction is fixed, but a subsequent probe correctly refuses the grouped 0.3/0.2 mm POFV ground via. Two local signal/power trace conflicts also remain.

12vhpwr-standard.note: This explicitly bound shadow used the earlier 78-open working source, not the current 72-open winner. It conflicts with a grouped pair-return GND via and a compact USB_CC2 portal, as well as local copper/mask geometry. It is NOT a current-board regression or a candidate to promote.

generic_constructor.scope: Private, transactional, ordinary ungrouped GND portal reconstruction; component ECO and current/return-loop/release qualification are outside its authority.
parameters: literal same-package surface GND pad UUIDs
generic_constructor.new_copper: Only guarded axis/45-degree full-source-class GND bridges when existing copper no longer reaches the moved barrel. An existing anchor's larger width is not reduced.
generic_constructor.rollback: A failed batch or exception restores all old via poses and destroys every newly added bridge.

qualification_needed_before_selection: Resolve exact drawing versus library land-pattern differences using actual contact extents and assembly tolerances; do not infer qualification from a generic library name.
Bind the complete vendored footprint, shell pin mapping, datasheet and actual 3D model to the selected MPN and source hierarchy.
Reconstruct grouped compact/pair-return portals through their actual owners and repeat process, pair/reference-plane and native receiving. Never reuse the ordinary-via tier as a waiver.
Repair the remaining exact USB ingress branch conflicts without changing the established current budgets or protected unrelated copper.
Archive the old source snapshots, perform a hash-bound full component ECO, and repeat current-source parity, native DRC, opens, stack/mating and source electrical checks before promotion.
Refresh live JLC stock/pricing before selection; retain physical sample fit, soldering and USB electrical qualification for the later full-suite review.
